We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is…

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

ashby:pointone:ead81d8b-5d51-4d1e-bfe5-6.summary:
The most valuable knowledge in a firm is in how its people work, and almost none of it is written down. PointOne builds the record of that work, capturing what people do each day and turning it into data that AI can understand.

More than 250 firms already rely on us, whether they use PointOne Time to turn the data into time entries, or PointOne Intelligence to understand their margin, profitability, and the ROI of their AI adoption.

PointOne is building toward a future where firms run on the record of their own work. We're a Series A company backed by YC, 8VC, General Catalyst, and Bessemer, based in New York City and working in person.

sections.title: The role
paras: You'll be PointOne's first Solutions Engineer, and you'll do engineering work for our sales team. On each deal, you'll find where a firm loses time and money, put a dollar figure on it, and build the demo that shows its leaders what PointOne would change.

Most of your time will go into demos, and you'll build every one from discovery. Within a few days of the first call, you'll set up a sample firm with the prospect's kind of clients, teams, and billing system, so its partners see their own work in PointOne. One week you might demo to a 10-person firm, and the next to a government agency or one of the largest law firms in the world. Our buyers are partners, CFOs, and operations leaders who test every claim, and accuracy matters as much as polish in everything you show them.

Firms that use PointOne measure a 9–15% increase in billable hours captured. You'll build the business case for each deal from the firm's own numbers, covering the billable time it never records, the hours its people spend on timekeeping, how long its billing takes, and its margin and staffing. You'll work with our Account Executives to set success criteria for each pilot, and you'll define how PointOne runs demos, including the standard demo for each of our four products and the handoff to our Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Success team when a pilot starts.

sections.title: The Role
paras: Solink is hiring a Director of Solutions Engineering to lead our two Solutions Engineering teams, covering SMB through Enterprise, and build a high-performing pre-sales technical organization across Solink’s software and hardware solutions.

You will own how Solink engages customers technically throughout the sales process, from discovery and solution design through demos, pilots, technical validation, and technical close. Your SEs will be the technical leaders of the deal and speak the language of the customer—the priorities, workflows, and challenges of each industry and persona we serve.

This role reports to the Senior Vice President of Revenue and partners closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Channel, and Implementation. The role will include occasional travel to events and customer sites across North America.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Lead the SE Organization: Lead, coach, and develop two SE teams and their leaders, with clear expectations, career paths, and performance standards. Run a consistent operating model across segments and focus SE capacity on the highest-value and most complex opportunities.

Drive Technical Sales Execution: Oversee technical discovery, solution design, demos, workshops, objection handling, competitive positioning, technical validation, closing, and clean handoff across the sales organization.

Build a World-Class Demo and Storytelling Culture: Set the standard for how Solink demonstrates its platform through customer use cases and business outcomes. Build repeatable demo frameworks and talk tracks by vertical and persona, and coach SEs on storytelling, executive presence, and technical credibility.

Design Solutions That Can Be Deployed: Ensure solutions account for customer camera, recorder, network, and POS infrastructure, including hardware needs, appliance sizing, bandwidth planning, site readiness, and deployment requirements.
Lead Technical Workshops & Pilots: Lead architecture discussions, site surveys, RFPs, security and compliance reviews, and pilot design, with clear success criteria and a path to full deployment.

Scale Technical Capability Beyond the SE Team: Partner with Sales Enablement to raise AE technical competency, help channel partners and installers become more technically self-sufficient, and define when partner-led scoping and installation is appropriate.
Partner with Product: Build a strong feedback loop with Product around recurring customer requirements, technical gaps, competitive intelligence, and field readiness for new launches.

sections.title: Role Expectations
paras: This is an M4 level role. At Solink, leaders at this level are accountable for leading through managers and driving the execution of significant initiatives across their area. They operate with a high degree of autonomy, translate strategy into clear priorities for their teams, and partner with senior leaders to solve complex problems and make effective decisions.
bullets: Set clear priorities and operating expectations across the Solutions Engineering organization, aligning team capacity and execution with broader Sales and company goals.
Lead and develop SE leaders and teams, creating accountability for performance while building capability, career growth, and succession within the organization.
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve technical sales execution, customer experience, and the scalability of the Solutions Engineering function.

Identify technical, operational, and capacity challenges early, develop thoughtful solutions, and proactively resolve dependencies across Sales, Product, Channel, Customer Success, and Implementation.
Use business and team performance metrics to evaluate SE effectiveness, prioritize investments, and make decisions that improve deal progression, technical quality, and organizational efficiency.
Drive adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance.

ashby:sparta-commodities:d5229aa3-fe67-4.summary:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell.…

sections.title: What You’ll Be Doing
paras: • Own a portfolio of smaller accounts, acting as the primary commercial point of contact for each customer.
• Build and execute a renewal plan for every account in your portfolio, working to protect and grow existing ARR.
• Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities (additional seats, products or commodity verticals) within your existing account base.

sections.title: About You
paras: • 2-3 years’ experience in an account management role, ideally in B2B SaaS, financial data or commodities.
• Hands-on ownership of both retention and expansion. You’ve run renewals and closed the upsell and cross-sell yourself, rather than passing growth opportunities to a separate salesperson to close.
• Comfortable managing a high volume of smaller accounts at once and prioritising your time effectively.

sections.title: Nice to Have Experience
paras: • Prior exposure to commodities, energy markets, or financial/data services.
• Experience with MEDDPICC or another value-selling framework.

sections.title: What's the Culture Like at Sparta?
paras: At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

ashby:stellic:ef09afb7-b923-41f2-beb5-e0.summary: Stellic's Explore product is our newest frontier. It's focused on the transfer experience — giving prospective and transfer students the guidance and pathways they need, and giving universities the tools to manage transfer rules, articulation, and admissions workflows. The roadmap is wide open. We're looking for a Product Lead who thrives in that kind of blank canvas, and who has the instincts to figure out what to build before anyone tells them.

sections.title: ABOUT YOU
paras: You've built products from scratch before — not contributed to someone else's vision, but started with a problem and figured out what to build. You're energized by ambiguity rather than paralyzed by it, and you know how to balance deep partner discovery with the conviction to make calls before all the data is in. You move fast, you learn constantly, and you hold yourself accountable for the outcome, not just the output.

sections.title: AS OUR PRODUCT LEAD FOR EXPLORE, YOU WILL OWN
bullets: The Explore product, end to end: Explore is Stellic's transfer experience product — covering transfer pathways, rules management, articulation, prospective student profiles, and admissions workflows. You're the ultimate owner of it, which right now means defining what it becomes.

The roadmap from the ground up: There's no inherited backlog to manage here. You'll do the discovery, identify the highest-leverage problems, and build a roadmap that earns trust with both university partners and internal leadership.

Partner-driven discovery: You'll be in the room — on calls, on-site when needed — learning how transfer processes actually work at different institutions and turning that into product decisions that scale.

Engineering partnership: You'll work daily with our engineering teams in the US and Pakistan, thinking through architecture, trade-offs, and sequencing together from the earliest stages of the product.

Pattern recognition across institutions: Transfer rules and requirements vary enormously across universities. You'll find the common threads and design solutions that work across many schools without building custom one-offs.
The long game: Even in a greenfield product, every decision you make shapes what's possible later. You'll need to hold the immediate build and the long-term platform vision at the same time.

sections.title: TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU SHOULD HAVE
bullets: 6+ years of PM experience with demonstrable growth in scope and ownership over time
True 0→1 experience — you've defined a product problem from nothing, built conviction around a solution, and shipped something real
Comfort with ambiguity — you don't need a clear spec to get started; you know how to structure discovery, form hypotheses, and make directional calls with incomplete information
Strong partner instincts — you're at home in customer conversations, you ask better questions than most, and you translate what you hear into product decisions rather than feature lists
Technical depth without needing to write code — comfortable in architecture discussions and able to think through how decisions made today constrain or enable what's possible tomorrow
An ownership mindset — on an early-stage product, everything is your problem; you don't wait to be asked
Clear, engaging communication — with university partners, engineers, and leadership; you can make a fuzzy problem feel structured and a hard trade-off feel obvious

sections.title: WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT STELLIC
bullets: Shape the future of higher education at a company leading the transformation of student success.
Work alongside an ambitious, mission-driven leadership team building something meaningful.
Own a piece of the journey with competitive salary, meaningful equity and a culture of excellence, speed and ownership.
Thrive in a flexible, outcome-driven culture built on trust and autonomy.
Exceptional benefits , including health insurance with Stellic covering 99% of your premium and 75% for dependents.
401(k), commuter benefits, and annual international retreats in incredible locations.

ashby:strava:e05740a1-ddc4-4241-88ec-2a3.summary:
Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.

Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.

sections.title: About This Role
paras: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead and improve the subscription experience across Strava. In this role, you will shape and run our conversion and monetization strategy, running fast-paced experiments to increase subscriber growth and retention. You will own the strategy for how users discover and experience Strava's full value, working closely with engineering, design, data, research, and marketing to understand the holistic journey and improve it.
We follow a flexible hybrid model that generally translates to around half of your time on-site in our San Francisco office—roughly three days per week.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the subscription strategy and roadmap to increase free-to-paid conversion and long-term subscriber retention.

Design and drive rigorous experiments that help us understand and learn about what drives purchase decisions across the full funnel – from pricing and packaging to messaging and value prop positioning.
Work closely with engineering, design, analytics, research, and marketing to deliver high-quality experiences.
Track and own core subscription health metrics—including conversion rates, churn, renewals, and lifetime value.
Communicate experimentation strategy, performance and trade-offs to product peers and leadership

sections.title: What You'll Bring to the Team
paras: For information on benefits, please click here .
bullets: 5+ years of experience managing global subscription products, conversion funnels, or driving growth in consumer software.
Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience with experimentation and A/B testing and evaluating results (e.g. conversion rate, trial-to-paid, plan mix shift, LTV)
A calm, adaptable operator who thrives amidst rapid change, bringing clarity and focus to a fast-paced environment.
Action-oriented mindset with the ability to prioritize work and solve complex problems, balancing a high quality user experience with revenue impact.
Clear communication skills, with the ability to build consensus across product, engineering, data, design, research, marketing, and leadership teams.

Remote candidates will ideally sit in the following states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MA, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OR, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI.

sections.title: About the Job
paras: Tapcheck's business runs on two numbers the Growth domain owns: how much earned-wage capacity we capture, and how much of it workers actually use. The Director of Product, Growth sets the strategy for both. You will lead the Supply and Engagement product teams through their leads, own the growth roadmap end to end, and be accountable to the VP of Product for the outcomes those teams deliver.

This is a leadership seat in a company that measures itself in outcomes, not output. Every team owns one number, every piece of work serves a named business result, and product and engineering leaders sit at the same table and build together. You will pair with the Growth engineering director to run the domain as one team, and you will be the single accountable leader for company-level growth initiatives that cut across domains.

sections.title: Own the Growth Strategy
paras: • Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcome metrics for the Growth domain: capture of eligible employers and employees on the supply side, and utilization of earned wages on the engagement side
• Set the targets for each Growth team, instrument them, and report progress and trade-offs to the executive team with a clear point of view
• Decide what the domain builds and what it does not, and defend those priorities with evidence from customers, data, and the market

sections.title: Lead the Growth Product Teams
paras: • Lead the Supply and Engagement product leads, setting direction, coaching craft, and holding each team to its number
• Raise the bar on discovery, problem definition, and PRD quality across the domain so engineering starts from well-defined work
• Hire, develop, and retain product talent as the domain grows, and build the next generation of product leaders inside the team

sections.title: Run the Domain as One Product and Engineering Team
paras: • Partner with the Growth engineering director to plan capacity, sequence delivery, and own results jointly
• Gain written alignment from the teams and partners affected by a change before it proceeds, and make room for others who need yours
• Use AI tools hands-on to accelerate discovery, prototyping, and analysis, and set the expectation that product leaders build, not just specify

ashby:vendelux:b07d5289-2ba6-427f-98c6-c.summary:
Vendelux is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Function as a true account manager across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and enablement through renewals, upsells, and negotiations
Own a portfolio of accounts simultaneously, managing competing priorities with urgency and precision — expect to juggle 9+ active workstreams at any given time
Lead structured onboarding and training programs that drive fast time-to-value and long-term product adoption
Run proactive meeting campaigns and renewal processes, ensuring no account goes dark or falls through the cracks
Negotiate renewals and expansions with confidence, building strong business cases that demonstrate clear ROI

Drive retention with a relentless, creative approach — exhaust every option before accepting churn, whether that's a LinkedIn message, an in-person office visit, a free pilot extension, or bringing in leadership to save the relationship
Travel to customer sites a minimum of 2 days per month to strengthen relationships and accelerate outcomes
Contribute to community building across the customer base through webinars, case studies, and events

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a hybrid of both — ideally at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company
Proven track record of owning the full client lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewals, upsells, and negotiations
Thrives in a fast-paced environment managing multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously without dropping the ball
Relentless when it comes to retention — you get creative, you show up, and you don't give up on an account easily
Comfortable traveling to meet customers in person and building face-to-face relationships
Highly accountable self-starter who doesn't need to be chased for updates
Strong communicator who can navigate difficult conversations with customers and internal stakeholders alike

Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.

We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

sections.title: About the job
paras: As the Director of Account Management, you will build and lead the success, growth, and retention of our health plan partnerships. A key focus of this role is ensuring clients achieve measurable outcomes through the successful adoption and expansion of Vynca’s core CalAIM lines of business - Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Supports (CS) - along with our active California Integrated Care Management (CICM) partnerships.

This role combines strategic partnership leadership and growth accountability. You will guide account strategy, ensure successful delivery across complex value-based healthcare partnerships, and drive portfolio growth through renewals, expansions and strong client outcomes. Deep working knowledge of Medi-Cal managed care contracting and CalAIM benefit categories is essential. The Manager of Account Management acts as both senior relationship lead and internal orchestrator, ensuring cross-functional teams deliver measurable value for clients while maintaining strong financial performance.
Kindly note we are only considering applicants in California at this time.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Serve as the relationship owner for our value-based health plan partnerships
Build trusted relationships across multiple stakeholders at the plan
Understand client strategic priorities, population health goals, and success metrics
Act as the primary advocate for client needs
Ensure long-term client satisfaction, retention, and strategic alignment
Establish and maintain scalable processes and playbooks for account management
Drive successful adoption and performance of ECM and support other active partnerships
Monitor performance against contracted metrics including Medi-Cal/DHCS requirements and CalAIM program deliverables for referral acceptance, member engagement, and care plan completion

sections.title: Your experience and qualifications
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field required; advanced degree (MBA, MHA, or similar) preferred.

10+ years of experience in account management, client partnerships, or strategic client success working with organizations servicing health plans in government-sponsored lines of business, including 5+ years with managed Medicaid and CalAIM.
Direct working knowledge of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) required; familiarity with California Integrated Care Management (CICM) and Community Supports (CS) highly preferred.
Experience partnering with health plans, value-based care organizations, health systems, and community-based provider networks, including ECM Lead Entities.
Strong understanding of Medi-Cal managed care contracting, DHCS requirements, and CalAIM policy guides.
Strong commercial acumen, including experience with contracts, pricing models, and margin management.
Track record of managing a high-value client portfolio, with measurable success in retention and partnership expansion.
Exceptional interpersonal and executive communication skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders.

ashby:whippy:24c4ebc1-ebb7-4002-97f4-2ab.summary:
Hi, I'm Joe, Head of Customer Success at Whippy. I'm hiring an Enterprise Implementation Manager to get customers live and seeing results fast, then keep them growing. Here, implementation doesn't end at go-live. You stay with your customers through renewal and expansion as their trusted advisor.

This role is for someone with 5+ years of experience. You'll own a focused book of our largest and most complex accounts, where a single customer can be worth six figures in ARR and involve executives, recruiters, and operations teams across many branches.

sections.title: Why I'm hiring
paras: At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers. That's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, AI agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1,000 businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

sections.title: Some things you'll do
bullets: Lead onboarding and implementation end to end : kickoff, ATS integration, configuration, training, and launch.
Get customers to their first measurable outcome fast , then build the next workflows, AI agents, and automations that grow their results.
Stay on after launch as their single point of contact and trusted advisor, with a proactive cadence of prepared calls, clear agendas, and mutual success plans through renewal and expansion.
Run multi-stakeholder relationships across executives, recruiters, and operations teams at our largest customers, with account plans to match.
Pick up the phone. Reach out proactively, ask the question instead of guessing, and get ahead of problems before they turn into escalations.
Own your gross and net revenue retention , and get rewarded for beating targets.
Tie usage to business outcomes , and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.
Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

sections.title: Our customer success values
paras: This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach and support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:
bullets: Everyone is a builder. Our team builds in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.
We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.
We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.
CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.
Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.
Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.
Comfortable getting technical. You don't need to code, but you're the kind of person who enjoys taking a tool apart, figuring out how it works, and building something useful with it.
Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.
Opinionated about customer experience. Good strategic advice needs well-formed views, so have them.
Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

5+ years in implementation , onboarding, or professional services at a technical SaaS product, including leading complex rollouts for large, multi-location customers. If your path is unconventional and you can explain how it'll help you succeed in this role, I welcome you to apply.

bamboohr:alkira:318.summary:
Department: Channel Sales / Partner Ecosystem

Alkira is the leader in AI-Native Network Infrastructure-as-a-Service (NIaaS). Founded in 2018 by Amir and Atif Khan — the team behind Viptela and the founding of the SD-WAN market — Alkira unifies any environment, site, or user through an enterprise network built entirely in the cloud, managed with the same controls, policies, and security systems network teams already know, and augmented by AI. There is no hardware to deploy, no software to download, and no new architecture to learn. Alkira is trusted by Fortune 100 enterprises, leading system integrators, and global managed service providers, and is part of Lumen Technologies.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: Alkira's partner ecosystem is growing fast: over 150 partners now drive more than 40% of total company revenue, and the 1,000th partner was recently enabled. In March 2026, Alkira launched Connect, its next-generation partner program built around a “Partner Profit Stack” of tiered margins, rebates, MDF, and velocity incentives — giving VAR’s, GSIs, MSPs, cloud service providers, and security/AI-focused firms a repeatable engine to attach high-value services to every deal. Alkira has also expanded successfully into Canada, making the Northeast U.S. and Eastern Canada a natural, connected territory for a single owner.

We are seeking a highly motivated Channel Account Manager based in Boston to own and grow Alkira's partner ecosystem across the Northeast U.S. and Eastern Canada (including markets such as Toronto, Ottawa, and Montreal). This role is responsible for recruiting, enabling, and driving revenue through the full range of partner types in the territory — VARs, GSIs, MSPs, TSDs/master agents, and cloud service providers — and for building the cross-border relationships needed to grow Alkira's presence on both sides of the border. The ideal candidate has established relationships with enterprise-focused partners in the Northeast corridor and is comfortable navigating the added complexity of a cross-border, dual-currency territory.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $96,038 - $160,051 and is based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Life at Alkira is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: The Partnership for Supply Chain Management (PFSCM) focuses on strengthening and managing secure, reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable global supply chains to enhance health and well-being in low- and middle-income countries by increasing access to quality and affordable health products. PFSCM is dedicated to customer satisfaction and service excellence, which is reflected in our adherence to an ISO 9001:2015 certified Quality Management System and alignment with ISO 20400 for Sustainable Procurement, which underpins all our processes and services.

PFSCM, an affiliate of JSI Research & Training Institute, Inc. We strive to create an environment where our values of collaboration, learning, proactivity, problem-solving, and outcome orientation are reflected in our daily work.

Advance Affirm’s lending, capital, and banking platforms. Guide the evolution of Loan Products, loan-lifecycle capabilities, Capital Markets systems, and Affirm Bank infrastructure. Develop shared capabilities that support new products and reduce fragmentation across financial systems.

Deliver meaningful business and customer impact. Establish clear goals and success metrics across platform reliability, payment performance, processing costs, reconciliation accuracy, operational efficiency, financial controls, and the speed of launching new products and markets.

Make sound platform investment decisions. Balance architectural modernization with product growth, regulatory requirements, operational risk, and near-term business needs. Establish clear sequencing and migration strategies for complex, interconnected systems.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are seeking an analytical, technically curious Product Manager to join our Server & AI Infrastructure team. As an OEM leader building next-generation compute platforms for hyperscalers, cloud service providers (CSPs), and enterprise AI deployments, we need a PM who can translate complex hardware requirements—spanning high-TDP GPUs, next-gen CPUs, and advanced liquid cooling architectures—into reliable, manufacturable server products.

In this role, you will work closely with hardware engineering, thermal/mechanical teams, ODM partners, and silicon vendors (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) to manage product execution from EVT/DVT/PVT milestones through mass production.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Product Execution & Lifecycle Management: Support the end-to-end hardware product lifecycle (NPI) for AI training/inference servers and high-density compute nodes, tracking deliverables across EVT, DVT, and PVT phases.

Requirements & Documentation: Author clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), feature specifications, and SKU matrices covering CPU/GPU configurations, PCIe Gen5/Gen6 topologies, high-speed networking (InfiniBand/Ethernet), and power/thermal envelopes.

Thermal & Liquid Cooling Coordination: Collaborate with thermal and mechanical engineering teams to define Direct-to-Chip (DLC) liquid cooling manifolds, cold plates, quick disconnects (UQD), and air-assisted liquid cooling (AALC) options.
Silicon & Ecosystem Alignment: Track roadmap updates from GPU, CPU, and DPU vendors to ensure timely platform readiness and compatibility testing.

Customer & Sales Enablement: Build competitive battlecards, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) calculators, datasheets, and technical presentations to support Solutions Architects and Sales teams during customer RFPs.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to monitor BOM costs, component lead times, and qualification schedules.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, Technical Program Management, Solutions Architecture, or Systems Engineering within server hardware, data center infrastructure, or semiconductor ecosystems.
Technical Foundation: Working knowledge of server architecture (x86/ARM CPUs, GPU accelerators, NVLink/PCIe fabrics, BMC/firmware management, and power distribution).
Thermal Awareness: Familiarity with high-density data center cooling challenges, including air cooling limits and Direct-to-Chip (DLC) liquid cooling components.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field (MBA or Master’s is a plus).
Skills: Strong analytical skills (BOM cost modeling, TCO analysis), clear technical writing, and ability to communicate effectively across hardware engineering and commercial teams.

Revenue Engineering builds the platform that measures how customers use Datadog and turns that measurement into usage and cost data they can act on. Every product Datadog ships is metered here. Every customer who wants to see which team, service, or business unit drove their usage sees it through this layer.

As a Staff Product Manager for Metering and Cost Attribution , you will own product direction for that platform. You will set the standard for how usage is measured, attributed, and presented across Datadog.

The role starts with tagging: the mechanism customers use to attribute usage to owners inside their organization, and the foundation that cost allocation, chargeback, quotas, and governance build on. From there you will shape the metering capabilities that new pricing and packaging models draw on, and extend the platform's speed and scale as Datadog's portfolio grows. Over…

sections.title: What You'll Do:
bullets: Set product direction for metering and attribution by defining the problems and outcomes that matter from usage events through billable output, holding a multi-quarter view of how the platform should evolve, and collaborating with multiple engineering teams to sequence work into phases that deliver clear customer value along the way.

Own the tagging model as a customer-facing product , giving customers a consistent way to define tags across every product, translating those tags into granular usage and cost breakdowns wherever they surface, and designing how customers adjust and reconstruct attribution when their tagging changes.

Define the metering and rating capabilities that pricing and packaging depend on , working ahead of launches on usage aggregation, unit definitions, commitments, included usage, and overage, so that the metering platform stays ahead of Datadog's commercial needs.

Build agentic capabilities on top of usage , surfacing an unexpected change in consumption early, explaining which teams and services drove it, and recommending what the customer can do next. Own the data contracts and interfaces that let agents across Datadog reason about usage.

Anticipate market movement in cost allocation and cost governance , tracking how FinOps practice, cloud provider primitives, and specialist vendors are evolving, shaping Datadog's investment in response, and engaging customers directly through preview programs, design partnerships, and industry forums.

sections.title: Who You Are:
bullets: A strong systems thinker : you can follow cause and effect from telemetry intake through metering, aggregation, attribution, and the bill, you reason about unit economics and cost-to-serve alongside customer experience, and you hold the throughline as scope evolves across quarters.

Fluent in data models and pipelines : you are at home in the concepts that usage data depends on, including event pipelines, usage aggregation, cardinality, deduplication, backfills, and processing latency, and you understand how they shape what a customer can be shown.
A cross-org synthesizer : you read across engineering teams, Support, Sales, Finance, and product verticals, and turn diffuse signals into a defensible product position.
Rigorous about quality : you treat accuracy in usage and cost data as a product standard you personally own, and you know how to balance investment in quality with new capability.

Collaborative and opinionated : you build trust quickly with engineers, PM peers, designers, and commercial partners, you influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and you adapt when new evidence emerges.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

paras: We've built the agentic platform to deploy self improving customer experiences. Now we build systems that scale those solutions.How our CSMs actually work
bullets: The buck stops with you. You will own and be accountable for the success of your customers. Not their happiness, their success.
You own a number. CSMs at Enterpret carry real business targets. No red/yellow/green theater.

Your operating rhythm is agent-led. Portfolio reviews, renewal prep, onboarding status, and upsell forecasting run on agents built against our own Knowledge Graph. You review, correct, and act on what the agents surface, and you improve the agents when they miss.

You build the automation you wish you had. Our CSMs write and maintain their own agent skills: account briefs before every call, exec engagement mapping, usage reports for renewal conversations, churn risk sweeps, case study drafts. If you do something manually twice, we expect you to ask whether an agent should do it the third time.
You tell stories with data. Monthly and quarterly reviews are grounded in evidence from the customer's own feedback: quantified themes, quotes, and outcomes, not usage screenshots.

Providing value that goes above and beyond what is currently possible within the product itself. We are the external representatives of our company, and we solve our customers' problems even when the product isn't quite there yet, increasingly by building agents that close the gap.
Owning a full book of business from onboarding through activation, renewal, and upsell. We aim to build multi-year partnerships with our customers. We are not transactional.
Being an advocate for our customers so that our product and engineering teams continue to build the right products for them. What better way to validate product ideas than to prove they are useful?

greenhouse:keepersecurity:4484626009.summary:
Keeper is hiring a driven, Implementation Engineer to join our B2B Support team. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago, Illinois.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while onboarding and supporting our customers as they integrate our platform into their business processes.

sections.title: About Keeper
paras: Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As the SaaS Implementation Engineer you are responsible for guiding customers through the process of integrating and implementing Keeper within our customer’s environment, ensuring a seamless transition from onboarding to full utilization. This role involves understanding customers’ business needs, configuring our Keeper software to meet those requirements, providing technical support, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Collaborate with customers to understand their specific business needs and objectives for using our services, conducting thorough needs assessments to gather requirements and tailor the implementation plan accordingly

Configure Keeper to meet the unique requirements of each customer, ensuring optimal system performance and usability while customizing features, workflows, and integrations based on customer specifications
Develop and deliver training sessions to educate customers on using Keeper effectively and efficiently
Create comprehensive documentation, user guides, and knowledge resources to support customers in using the software

Offer continuous level 2 related technical support to customers, adeptly troubleshooting issues and efficiently resolving any concerns as they arise while proactively recognizing and rectifying project-related risks and issues, promptly escalating them when required
Maintain accurate records of customer configurations, customizations, and communication to ensure a comprehensive understanding of each implementation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product development, sales, and customer success, to ensure alignment and successful customer implementations
Participate in internal meetings to provide insights into customer needs and help improve Keeper based on feedback

Experience in SaaS deployment with security software experience preferred
Working knowledge and hands on experience with Salesforce preferred
Experience with Google docs and MS-office tools
Mac OS, Windows & Linux administration and troubleshooting experience

Advanced knowledge in Firewalls, AD environments, DNS Servers, Authentication protocols, LDAP
Advanced knowledge in on prem/cloud/hybrid environments

greenhouse:kinders:5287939008.summary:
What’s it like to work at Kinder’s? Well, there’s a lot of snacking and geeking out over what we all cooked over the weekend. Beyond that, there’s also plenty of hard work. Because we don’t just like flavor, we’re obsessed with it.

With over 100 products sold nationwide, we’re now a top-five brand in multiple flavor categories at Costco, Walmart, Whole Foods, and more. We’re not your typical CPG company. Privately held and founder-led, we like to think of ourselves as a pirate ship in a sea of cruise ships . Our crew is adventurous and fearless. We chart our own course and chase big ideas to make food unforgettable.

sections.title: BUILT ON FLAVOR. FUELED BY PEOPLE.
paras: As we expand globally and approach $1 billion in revenue, we need more smart-and-scrappy, flavor-obsessed people to come aboard. If you’re looking for a place where you can see the real impact of your work... this is it! Every day, you’ll be part of a journey to add flavor to millions of meals and lives.

sections.title: Your Impact at Kinder's
paras: Kinder’s Operations team is looking for an analytical, solutions-driven team member to own the investigation and resolution of operational service issues. This person will act as both a detective and a problem-solver — validating customer complaints or charges, identifying the true root causes, and pushing toward resolution either through claim recovery or internal process improvement.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities Include:
bullets: Investigate service-related issues such as customer shorts, OTIF fines, late fees, missed appointments, spoilage, damages, and chargebacks.
Validate or challenge claims based on data and documentation.
File and manage disputes/claims and follow through to resolution, including collections if needed.
If the issue is valid, identify internal causes, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to address the root cause and prevent recurrence.
Track and report on trends in service issues to identify systemic problems and opportunities for improvement
Build strong working relationships across Supply Chain, Customer Service, Sales, and Finance to drive faster resolution and continuous improvement.

sections.title: Skills + Experience:
bullets: Capable of working alone or cross functionally to research and resolve discrepancies.
A critical thinker with a nose for digging into the why behind a problem.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and conflicting information.
Obsessed with getting to resolution — whether through recovery or fixing what’s broken.
Accountable, detailed, and not afraid to challenge the status quo if it means getting to the truth.
Someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where every issue is a learning opportunity
Ability to create, document and refine process.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in supply chain, customer operations, or logistics in the CPG industry.

sections.title: About The Role
paras: Kinder's is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Customer Excellence to manage the processes, systems and performance practices that help Customer Operations scale with the business. This hands-on leader will build and develop a team of two Senior Customer Excellence Analysts.

We are a fast-growing company working hard to bring amazing flavor solutions that are as exciting and delicious as they are simple to use. We are obsessed with quality and are 100% committed to being the most innovative company in any market we serve. Our mission is to bring awesome flavor to consumers whenever and wherever they are looking for it. We have experienced tremendous growth, but we think we are just getting started.

Today, we have over 100 products sold nationwide at retailers including Costco, Walmart, Sam's Club, Whole Foods, Sprouts, Kroger, Safeway and many more. To keep our momentum rolling, we need more passionate flavor advocates and builders to join our team and help us reach every kitchen across the U.S. and maybe even the world.

sections.title: Customer Operations Excellence and Process Governance
bullets: Manage and execute the Customer Operations excellence roadmap in partnership with the Senior Director, prioritizing improvements that strengthen service, accuracy, efficiency and scalability.
Own the end-to-end order-to-cash process framework across customer setup, order receipt, EDI, order management, inventory and allocation, fulfillment, invoicing, deductions and issue resolution.
Document current and future-state workflows, clarify roles and decision rights, and establish controls that reduce manual work and prevent recurring errors.
Create, govern and continuously improve SOPs, work instructions, process maps and training materials; maintain clear ownership and review cycles.

sections.title: Systems Implementation and EDI Enablement
bullets: Support Customer Operations in design and implementation, including requirements, process decisions, testing, data readiness, training, cutover and post-launch stabilization.
Lead Customer Operations readiness for EDI and customer onboarding, coordinating trading-partner requirements, mapping, testing, issue resolution and handoff to ongoing support.
Partner with IT, Finance, Sales, Planning, Inventory, Warehousing and Logistics to connect system design with practical order-to-cash execution.
Identify system gaps and manual touchpoints, then develop clear requirements and adoption plans that improve data quality and user effectiveness.

greenhouse:klaviyo:7806008003.summary: At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

sections.title: About the Team
paras: Klaviyo's Personalization & Analytics pillar builds the intelligence layer that helps marketers understand their customers, personalize every interaction, and prove the impact of their work. Our Personalization SKU — which includes Audience Optimization and our personalization engine — is one of Klaviyo's highest-growth paid products and a cornerstone of our Marketing Analytics & Personalization offering.

The Personalization SKU is ML-powered, which means the value it delivers is real and differentiated — but it also means customers need to understand what it's doing before they trust it, and trust it before they pay for it. That gap between "this exists" and "I can't imagine working without this" is where this role lives.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who is obsessed with one question above all others: why do customers adopt — or fail to adopt — a product that would genuinely help them?

This isn't a traditional growth PM role. We're not looking for someone who runs A/B tests on button colors and calls it a day. We're looking for someone who understands that sustainable SKU growth comes from product quality and value clarity first — and that the best conversion and retention lever is an experience so good that customers can't explain their business performance without it.

Your primary mandate is the adoption, retention, and trial conversion of the Personalization SKU. That means owning the in-product experiences that help customers discover Personalization features, understand what they're doing, trust the results, and build habits around them. It means making the ROI of Personalization impossible to miss — not through marketing copy, but through product design. And it means owning the analytics surfaces that make that value visible: the dashboards, metrics, and reporting experiences that connect Personalization usage to business outcomes customers care about.

sections.title: How You'll Make a Difference
bullets: Own the end-to-end in-product experience for Personalization SKU trial and adoption — from first contact with an Audience Optimization or personalization feature through the moment a customer builds a sustained usage habit
Define and track what real adoption looks like for each Personalization feature — not surface engagement, but the behaviors that actually predict retention and expansion

Own the in-product analytics and reporting surfaces that make Personalization ROI visible to customers — the dashboards, performance summaries, and impact metrics that answer "what is this doing for my business?"

Design and iterate on the trial conversion experience: make it unmistakably clear what customers get with Personalization, reduce the distance between signup and first value moment, and build in-product signals that accelerate the path from trial to paid
Identify and close the gaps in the Personalization customer journey where value is unclear, trust breaks down, or usage falls off — and build the product experiences that fix them
Build and maintain a rigorous measurement framework for Personalization SKU health: adoption depth, retention rates, trial conversion, expansion signals, and churn indicators

Partner with go-to-market, customer success, and data science to ensure the Personalization SKU can convert and retain customers through both self-serve and sales-assisted motions — and that the product experience works for both

Synthesize customer feedback, usage data, and market signals into a clear point of view on what Personalization customers need next — and turn that into a sequenced roadmap that shipping teams can execute

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: You have 3–5+ years of PM experience, with a demonstrable track record of driving product adoption, retention, or trial conversion for a paid B2B SaaS product — not just shipping features
You think about growth as a product quality problem: the most durable conversion and retention motion is a product experience so good that customers understand the value without being told
You have strong UX instincts, especially for products where the underlying complexity is high — you've taken something hard to understand and made it feel intuitive, trustworthy, and worth paying for
You know how to define and measure real adoption: you've questioned inherited engagement metrics, replaced them with something that actually predicts retention, and gotten stakeholders to buy in
You've owned a trial-to-paid conversion motion and can speak to what you changed in the product — not the marketing or lifecycle emails, but the actual in-product experience

You have genuine customer empathy: you talk to customers regularly, know how to synthesize what you hear into product decisions, and can advocate for the customer POV in a room full of people looking at dashboards
You can hold a PLG motion and a sales-assisted motion simultaneously — you understand that the product has to work for both and you've navigated the design tradeoffs that creates
You're data-literate: you can define your own success metrics, pull and interpret data to inform decisions, and build a measurement framework for a product area you've never owned before

greenhouse:mixmode:5283603007.summary: MixMode is a leading provider of AI-powered cybersecurity solutions at scale, pioneering a patented third-wave, context-aware AI approach that automatically learns and adapts to dynamic environments. The MixMode platform delivers self-supervised, real-time threat detection for known and unknown threats across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Large organizations with big data workloads – including those in the US Department of War, US Intelligence Community, Utilities, State/Local and Enterprise – trust MixMode to defend their most important assets. Backed by PSG and Entrada Ventures, MixMode is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at www.mixmode.ai .

sections.title: Job Summary:
paras: MixMode is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team, remotely or in our Santa Barbara office. This person will own the integration ecosystem for the MixMode platform: the connectors, outbound integrations and data formats that deliver MixMode's AI-driven detections into customers' existing SOC workflows (SIEM, SOAR, ticketing and data lake tools) for investigation and response. They will set direction for this area, partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and have direct visibility with company leadership.

The ideal candidate is an experienced enterprise product manager with a track record of shipping complex technical products: someone who has owned a product area from problem definition through launch, made and defended hard prioritization calls, and delivered on a cadence. They are comfortable in deep technical conversations with engineers and in front of customers and executives, thrive in a fast-moving startup, turn ambiguity into clear priorities, and write well, because written narratives are how we make decisions.
Security experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.

sections.title: What you’ll be doing (responsibilities):
bullets: Drive execution: Own delivery end to end for your product area. Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; work day to day with Engineering and Data Science through design, build and release; manage dependencies, clear blockers and ship what was committed, adjusting as priorities shift.

Own the roadmap: Define and prioritize the roadmap for the integration ecosystem based on customer needs, market and competitive insight, and business goals; communicate trade-offs and timelines clearly to stakeholders.
Build the integration ecosystem: Own both directions of the ecosystem.
Inbound: the connectors that bring customer telemetry into MixMode (network sensors, cloud audit and flow logs, EDR/XDR, identity, and other security data sources).
Outbound: the integrations that deliver MixMode detections into customers' existing workflows (SIEM, SOAR, ticketing and data lake platforms) in the formats customers and partners need.

Know the customer: Run ongoing discovery with customers, prospects, partners and SOC practitioners; synthesize input from Sales, Customer Success, industry analysts and security research into clear problem statements.
Measure what matters: Define success metrics for your features (adoption, time to value, integration reliability, retention) and use data to guide iteration.
Enable go-to-market: Partner with Marketing on positioning, messaging, launches, demos and collateral; train Sales, Sales Engineering and partners; join key customer and prospect conversations.

sections.title: What you’ll need to bring (qualifications):
bullets: 6+ years of product management experience with enterprise B2B software or SaaS products, with a track record of owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration
Evidence of product judgment: you have made and defended hard prioritization calls, cut scope to ship, and delivered on a cadence, and you can walk us through those decisions in detail

Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable in a writing-first organization where one-pagers, PRDs and PRFAQs drive decisions, and able to explain product vision, strategy and value to technical and executive audiences

3+ years owning integration, API, connector or data pipeline products (data ingestion, partner or third-party integrations, marketplace apps, etc.), with hands-on experience in how data moves between systems (ingestion, normalization, schemas, reliability at scale, etc.)
Experience working day to day with Engineering and Data Science on model-driven or data-driven features
Strong grounding in the software development lifecycle and Agile methods
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to turn complex technical ideas into clear, actionable plans
Comfortable with ambiguity and able to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment while collaborating across teams

sections.title: From the job description
paras: The Product Marketing Manager is responsible for launching and enhancing products by working cross-functionally with the product management team to surface client and user insights that inform the roadmap and leverage those to build scaled go-to-market campaigns that encourage adoption of those solutions. Product marketers will own the product and solution brand strategy, product hierarchy, value proposition, buyer personas, and positioning for their products and solutions. They will act as the bridge between technical product knowledge and how the product is marketed and sold.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:
Within your first 90 days, we expect you to learn our products, understand our positioning and messaging across each product and the platform, and know our go-to-market process, including the templates and requirements needed to take a product or release to launch. By month six, you should be confident in managing a medium-sized launch from planning through execution. You should be comfortable with our various sources of data and deliver insights cross functionally that shape product discovery, validate our positioning, and improve our sales process. Success here is measured by quality as much as output: we look for launches that hit their dates with complete, accurate assets, messaging that client facing teams can use without rework, and market insights and intelligence that product can act on. The product marketers who grow fastest here are the ones who ask hard questions about the product, seek genuine understanding our our target clients, and test our messaging against what clients say. Over time, that foundation leads to full end-to-end ownership of larger launches.

Job Responsibilities
bullets: Understand the market and our clients better than anyone else: What are the pain points, how MX solves them, and what needs will come in the future

Develop and execute world-class launch plans for new solution offerings both to internal stakeholders and the market. Including positioning, messaging, buyer personas, sales strategy, and GTM for your product areas through the full product life-cycle
Own marketing support for product and solution areas, including asset creation, training materials, campaign planning, and industry-leading thought leadership content
Inform product development and roadmap of market needs for your products

Researching and understanding the competitive landscape for your product and solutions to know how we win and opportunities to improve our place in the market. Then developing compelling competitive assets and messaging that drive engagement and interest.
Monitor and own metrics regarding revenue, pipeline, win rate, and adoption metrics for product and solution areas
Work cross-functionally with Customer Marketing and Demand Marketing to launch integrated marketing campaigns to drive awareness and generate demand for your product and solution areas.
Work cross-functionally with Customer Marketing and Product Management to surface success stories and new use cases that prove ROI

greenhouse:nice:5036198101.summary: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

sections.title: So, what’s the role all about?
paras: The Product Manager is responsible for defining, developing, and executing product strategy and roadmap initiatives within NiCE's CX portfolio. This individual will work closely with Engineering, Product Development, Design, Marketing, Sales, and other cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that enhance customer experiences and drive business value.

This role will play an important part in advancing AI-driven product innovation, with a particular focus on generative AI, agentic AI, and AI-assisted development. The Product Manager will leverage emerging AI technologies and tools, such as Claude and other AI-powered platforms, to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, requirements development, and solution delivery.

The ideal candidate is curious, innovative, and comfortable working at the intersection of product management and emerging technology. They understand how AI agents and intelligent automation can transform software capabilities, streamline workflows, and create new opportunities for customer experience innovation.

sections.title: How will you make an impact?
bullets: Support the development and execution of product strategy, vision, and roadmaps for assigned product areas within NiCE's CX portfolio.
Drive product discovery and innovation by identifying opportunities to incorporate generative AI, agentic AI, and intelligent automation into product capabilities.
Leverage AI-powered tools and agentic development platforms, such as Claude or similar technologies, to accelerate prototyping, product exploration, requirements definition, and solution design.
Partner with Engineering and Development teams to translate product concepts and customer needs into clear requirements, user stories, and actionable development plans.
Explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and capabilities to identify opportunities for product innovation and competitive differentiation.
Participate in the design and development of AI-powered features, intelligent agents, and automated workflows that enhance customer experiences.
Gather customer feedback, conduct market research, and analyze industry trends to inform product decisions and prioritization.
Manage product backlogs, prioritize features, and balance competing business and technical requirements.

sections.title: Have you got what it takes?
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
4–5 years of product management experience, preferably within SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-driven organizations.
Demonstrated interest or experience in generative AI, agentic AI, and emerging AI technologies.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered tools and platforms, such as Claude or similar technologies, to support product discovery, prototyping, requirements development, or solution design.
Understanding of how AI agents, intelligent automation, and generative AI can be applied to enterprise software and customer-facing solutions.
Experience working with Agile and Scrum development methodologies.
Ability to translate business needs and customer feedback into product requirements, user stories, and development priorities.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

sections.title: What's in it for you?

As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Now, we’re scaling to become one of the largest sources for new customer acquisition worldwide. Read more about our growth here .

sections.title: What you will do:

Proactively monitor partner performance and translate data into clear narratives, executive-level insights, and actionable recommendations that influence partner decisions

Prior experience launching, managing, nurturing, and scaling relationships with high-value supply-side partnerships

smartrecruiters:nbcuniversal3:7440001607.summary: The Senior Product Manager, SAP GRC is an integral part of the Corp Core Innovation & Operations organization, reporting directly to the Director, GRC. This role leads the strategy and execution of complex SAP security and access-governance initiatives across NBCU, using advanced functional and technical expertise to evaluate multiple variables, resolve complex problems, and enhance methods, systems, and tools. The Senior Product Manager serves as a subject matter expert for SAP GRC and security, provides technical guidance and oversight, drives architecture and design decisions, and ensures successful delivery of high-impact initiatives. The role also mentors and coaches associates, advises stakeholders on complex matters, adapts communication to influence audiences across the broader business, and may be accountable through the team for delivery of tactical business targets.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
bullets: Lead the implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of SAP GRC Access Control (AC) and Identity and Access Governance (IAG) modules, ensuring successful execution across complex, interdependent workstreams.

Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) security concepts, including identity authentication, authorization, role collections, destination security, and integration with enterprise identity providers.
Working knowledge of SAP Joule and AI-enabled SAP solutions, with an understanding of security, access governance, data privacy, and responsible AI considerations in SAP environments.
Ability to support security design for SAP BTP extensions, Fiori applications, cloud integrations, and AI-driven business processes across SAP S/4HANA and connected systems.
Familiarity with securing and governing emerging SAP capabilities such as Joule, generative AI, workflow automation, and cloud application services within SAP’s security and compliance framework.

Lead collaboration with architecture, application, engineering, business, and compliance teams to evaluate and implement secure access models for SAP BTP, AI services, and intelligent automation solutions; provide technical guidance and drive architecture and design decisions.
Design and implement role-based access controls (RBAC), firefighting, and segregation of duties (SoD) rules to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and company policies.

Build and maintain a network of key contacts across and beyond the immediate area of expertise; influence senior stakeholders, adapt communication style, and use persuasion to translate business needs into scalable technical specifications and delivery priorities.

sections.title: Requirements:
bullets: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
10+ years of experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC, Identity and Access Management, or related SAP security disciplines.
Strong knowledge of the SAP Authorization Concept, including roles, profiles, authorization objects, user administration, and troubleshooting authorization issues.
Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining SAP security roles and authorizations across SAP S/4HANA, MDG, BW4HANA, SAC, CIS/BTP environments.

Strong working knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control, including Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Business Role Management (BRM), Emergency Access Management (EAM/Firefighter), and MSMP workflows.
Experience performing Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis, security risk assessment, remediation, and mitigation.
Experience supporting SAP security implementations, upgrades, migrations, and production environments.
Knowledge of application security concepts across ABAP, SAP HANA, Fiori, and related SAP technologies.

sections.title: Desired Characteristics:
bullets: 12+ years of experience as an SAP Security and/or SAP GRC professional, preferably in large, complex enterprise environments.
Demonstrated leadership of at least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including architecture and design decisions, cross-functional delivery, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.
Preferred experience with 3 to 5 full lifecycle SAP Security/GRC implementations, particularly across SAP S/4HANA, and SAP GRC Access Control/Process Control 12.x.
Deep expertise in one or more SAP Security/GRC domains with demonstrated credibility as a Subject Matter Expert (SME).

Experience designing SAP security architecture and authorization models for SAP S/4HANA and Fiori, including business roles, catalogs, spaces/pages, OData services, and backend authorization requirements.
Experience with SAP HANA security, including database roles, privileges, and integration with application-level security.
Experience with SAP cloud security technologies such as SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS and IPS, SAP IAG, and SAP Analytics Cloud, where applicable.
Experience integrating SAP security with enterprise Identity and Access Management and Privileged Access Management solutions.
